Project Narrative:
Applicant, 6453 § Bell, LLC, an Illinois limited liability company, is the owner of the subject property and secking

a Type 1 Map Amendment to rezone the subject property from M1-2 :0B3-2,

The subject property, now vacant, was previously operated as a setni-conductoc, computer, and clectronic
manufacturing warehouse. Tt is currently zoned M1-2, but is not within a designaced Industrial Cortidor or within
660" feet of the nine uses specified under 17-3-0307 of the Zoning Ordinance that would trigger a Special Use requirement.
(See attached Architect’s Certificate.) The property is rectangular in shape and located at the Norcheas: cotner of South
Bell Avenue and West 65t Street. The West side of South Bell Avenue is part of an established residential community
within the West Englewood neighborhood, Elevated railroad tracks and industrial properties are located to the East and
Notth.

If the requested rezoning is approved, Applicant and its affiliate will extensively renovate the cxisting
improvements and operate them as a high-quality and much-needed carly childcare center. The facility design will meet
national standards for childcare facilities established by the National Association for the Education of Young Children
and Head Scart while incteasing energy efficiency and improved indoor air quality, Work scope will include new
finishes and lighting, upgraded mechanical (HVAC) and electrical systems, additional restrooms to meet City of Chicago
Building Code requirements, Director and Staff offices near main entryways, and classrooms with direct access to
outdoor arcas.

Beyond the extensive building improvements, exterior site work wil] include: (i) installing an ornamental metal fence, (i)
creating an outdoor playground area: (iii) planting ten new trees and new sod within the parkways, {iv) adding
new building foundation plantings; and (v) planting eleven additional tees and shrubs within the site, meeting
all Vehicular Use Area requirements under the Zoning Ordinance.

Applicant, in coordination with the Alderman and staff of the 16 Ward, has engaged in extensive community outreach,
including door-to-door conversations with residential neighbors, As a cesult of this outreach, Applicant has
received multiple letters of support from active community organizations and leaders in the neighborhood.

Project Information Required for Type | Applications:
a) Proposed Land Use: Day Care, with allowable accessory uses.

b) Project Floor Area Ratio: The subject property has a surveyed site area of 29,958 sf. Applicant is not currently
proposing to increase the Floor Area of cither the existing primary building (approximately 10,069sf) or
accessory structure (approximately 1,400s6). If the accessory structure is allowed to be used for accessory uses, site
FAR will be 0.38. If it is required to be used as a parking garage, the site FAR will be 0.34. Either condition will
be in compliance with the maximum allowable FAR in the B3-2 District (2.2).

c) Project Density (lot atea per dwelling): No residential units are being proposed at this time.

d) Amount of off-street parking: As shown in the attached plans, 14 outdoor parking spaces are proposed
(including one ADA space). Applicant wil seck a Parking Determination Letter in conjunction with this map
amendment application and request che flexibility to use the ancillary structure for accessory uses other than
parking. If the final Parking Determination docs not permit this, the structure can be used as a garage and
would accommodate 4 additional cats.

e) Setbacks: No modifications to existing setbacks are being proposed at chis time, The primary building
setbacks are approximately 19’5” feet from the South property line; 83'4” from the North; 235” from the
Fasy, and 18°3” from the West. Given abutting uses, no front, rear or side setbacks are required under the exisung or
proposed zoning.

f) Building Heights: The only contemplated modification to existing building heights would be installation of a skylighe
to bting natural light into the primary building. The resulting maximem building height (approximately
20°) will comply with che maximum allowable height for the site with B3-2 zoning (50’). Both structures are one-story.

Attached Exhibits: Site plans, Drawings and Illustrations showing:
a) building location, orientation and setbacks.
b) building bulk and scale in tclation to nearby buildings.
c) the location of curb cuts, sidewalks, and parking and loading.
d) landscaping and on-site open space.
e) location of dumpsters or trash enclosures.
